title: Trunk Ports & VLAN Verification
description: Configure a trunk port between switches and verify VLANs are carried correctly.
scenario: Configure a trunk port between switches and verify VLANs are carried correctly.

objectives.text: Set the port to trunk mode

concepts.title: Trunk Ports
concepts.body: A trunk carries multiple VLANs between switches. It uses 802.1Q tagging so each frame knows its VLAN.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/1
SW1(config-if)# switchport mode trunk

concepts.title: Access vs Trunk
concepts.body: Access ports carry one VLAN (untagged). Trunk ports carry many VLANs (tagged with 802.1Q).
concepts.code:
Access: Fa0/1 → VLAN 20
Trunk:  Gi0/1 → VLANs 1-4094

concepts.title: Verifying Trunks
concepts.body: "show interfaces trunk" shows trunk status, encapsulation, and which VLANs are allowed.
concepts.code:
SW1# show interfaces trunk
Port   Mode  Encapsulation  Status
Gi0/1  on    802.1q         trunking
